title: Increasing Skill Level Recruits Deeper Attention Layers in a Frozen Chess Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2609.23917v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chess involves complex reasoning in a deterministic environment, which makes it a useful setting for studying the mechanisms of computation inside transformers. The Maia-3 chess transformer takes Elo, a measure of competitive chess skill, as an input to the pre-trained network, so we can vary the skill the network is conditioned on with no change to its weights. Here we investigate how turning this skill dial affects self-attention. Ablating every attention head at every Elo from 700 to 2500, we find 1) increasing skill pushes the causal center of mass of the computation deeper, monotonically, for every chess piece and move type we measured; 2) the depth migration is much greater for specific tactics, especially knight forks, than for other move types; 3) the migration consists of deeper heads getting recruited for more specialized computations while one shared shallow head keeps a roughly constant contribution. translated_title: 提高技能水平会在冻结的国际象棋Transformer中招募更深的注意力层
translated_abstract: 国际象棋在确定性环境中涉及复杂的推理，这使其成为研究Transformer内部计算机制的有用场景。Maia-3国际象棋Transformer将Elo（衡量竞技国际象棋水平的指标）作为预训练网络的输入，因此我们可以在不改变网络权重的情况下调节网络所条件化的技能水平。在此，我们研究了调节这个技能旋钮如何影响自注意力机制。通过在700到2500的每个Elo级别上消融每一个注意力头，我们发现：1）提高技能水平会使计算中的因果质心向更深层单调推移，这在我们测量的每一种棋子和走法类型上都成立；2）对于特定战术，尤其是骑士双叉（knight forks），这种深度迁移远大于其他走法类型；3）这种迁移的机制是更深的注意力头被招募来执行更专门化的计算，同时一个共享的浅层注意力头保持大致恒定的贡献。这些结果可能有助于揭示……
tldr: 该论文发现，在权重冻结的国际象棋Transformer中提高条件化技能水平，会单调地将计算迁移到更深的注意力层，使深层注意力头被招募执行更专门化的计算，且这种深度迁移在骑士双叉等特定战术上尤为显著。
en_tdlr: Increasing the conditioned skill level in a frozen chess transformer monotonically recruits deeper attention layers for more specialized computations, with depth migration being especially pronounced for specific tactics like knight forks.
